Recommends design changes as needed and ensures contractor-submitted mechanical equipment and shop drawings meet specifications. Provides professional expertise and advice on matters involving design and construction for FBI projects and its architectural, engineering and construction contractors, other government agencies and private lessors.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the second lower grade/level position in the federal service or equivalent (GS-05).

GS-09 Specialized Experience: one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service performing both of the following duties:1) identifying problems and recommending corrective action for mechanical engineering systems; AND 2) assisting higher graded engineers with preparing designs (plans and specifications) for residential, commercial or industrial settings.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service or equivalent (GS-07) OR, Education: Master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree in a field which demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work of the position, such as engineering; OR, Combination of Education and Experience: A combination of education and experience may be used to qualify for this position as long as the computed percentage of the requirements is at least 100%.

To compute the percentage of the requirements, divide your total months of experience by 12. Then divide the total number of completed graduate semester hours (or equivalent) beyond the first year (total graduate semester hours minus 18) by 18. Add the two percentages.

GS-11 Specialized experience: one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service performing both of the following duties: 1) develop mechanical engineering specifications for major maintenance projects; AND 2) inspect equipment related to mechanical engineering systems.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service or equivalent (GS-09).

OR, Education: Ph..D. or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree in a field which demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work of the position, such as engineering; OR, Combination of Education and Experience: A combination of education and experience may be used to qualify for this position as long as the computed percentage of the requirements is at least 100%.

To compute the percentage of the requirements, divide your total months of experience by 12. Then divide the total number of completed graduate semester hours (or equivalent) beyond the second year (total graduate semester hours minus 36) by 18. Add the two percentages.

GS-12 Specialized Experience: one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-11 level in the Federal service which includes 2 out of 3 following: 1) developing engineering designs/plans for mechanical systems for power plant production projects; OR 2) monitoring mechanical design/construction activities for operations and maintenance projects; OR 3) performing quality control reviews and inspections of manufacturing mechanical components of major projects.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service or equivalent (GS-11). For the GS-12 level, you must meet the qualification requirement using experience alone -- no substitution of education for experience is permitted.

About the Role As a Senior Mechanical Engineer on our AV Labs Hardware team, you will own and drive the mechanical structural design and system integration of critical vehicle subsystems, including complex sensor arrays and computation modules.

By executing design for manufacturability (DFM) and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and global manufacturing vendors, you will shepherd complex hardware from the initial proof-of-concept phase through to mass production.

Ultimately, your innovative solutions and rigorous validation strategies will directly impact the reliability, safety, and scalable deployment of our next-generation autonomous data collection fleet.

What the Candidate Will Do Drive mechanical structural design projects as the end-to-end owner of a mechanical module, taking full responsibility for on-time delivery of design release and product launch.

You will contribute to architecture definition and execute the integration of sensor systems, computation modules, and cabin hardware from the requirement collection phase through to final launch.

Build and iterate on the integration of mechanical structures, enclosures, sensors, harnesses, PCBAs, and thermal modules at both the component level and the overall vehicle module level.

Execute mechanical component validation and testing by drafting comprehensive test plans, customizing testing profiles, building test fixtures, and collaborating closely with external labs.

Partner with local and global cross-functional teams , OEMs, and manufacturing vendors to shepherd projects through design, DFM, DFA, prototyping, iteration builds, and into mass production.

Create and maintain essential engineering documentation -including BOMs, SOPs, and troubleshooting instructions-and provide hands-on training and handovers to technicians.

Basic Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering alongside 7+ years of industrial experience in product mechanical design, with a strong preference for backgrounds in autonomous driving, consumer electronics, or semiconductors.

Expertise in 3D CAD modeling (such as Solidworks, CATIA) and GD&T, coupled with hands-on experience integrating complex mechanical structures, sensor systems, compute modules, and thermal components.

Proven track record navigating full-cycle product development from Proof of Concept (POC) to Mass Production (MP), demonstrating deep proficiency in DFM, DFA, FMEA, prototyping, and design validation.

Preferred Qualifications Advanced proficiency in structural and thermal simulation tools , including FEA and CFD (such as ANSYS, Icepack, and Solidworks Simulation), alongside experience utilizing Matlab for data analysis and modeling.

Demonstrated project management experience and the ability to own complex subsystem designs, influence architecture decisions, oversee system integration, and mentor junior engineers.

Extensive hands-on background in mechanical component validation and testing, specifically in drafting test plans, collaborating with external labs, customizing testing profiles, and building custom test fixtures.

Strong capability to collaborate with global cross-functional teams, OEMs, and manufacturing vendors (such as Asia FATP), driving DFM, DOEs, and FACA to successfully resolve complex quality and build issues. ~~ ~~ For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $180,000 per year - USD $200,000 per year.

At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization.

If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are looking to add a Principal Mechanical Design Engineer I to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.
In this position, you will be responsible for the mechanical design of Cesium products through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in electronics packaging design, mechanical simulations and analyses, computer-aided design (CAD), spacecraft mechanical interfaces, and environmental qualification of electronic assemblies.
As a principal mechanical team member, you will be responsible for mechanical designs from initial concept design through requirements definition, detailed design, simulation, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support of Cesium's products.

Required skills and experience include thermal management design, precision machining principles, thermal simulation and analysis, shock and vibration simulation and analysis, electromagnetic interference/compatibility (EMI/EMC) mitigation techniques, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), finite element analysis (FEA), and cost analysis to develop, validate, and optimize mechanical designs.

Principal engineers also serve as technical and professional mentors in their field, helping to cultivate and develop junior engineers on the team.
The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

A Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited university or institution.
9 years of industry experience in design and analysis of electronics packaging, including thermal, vibration, and stress dynamics hand calculations and simulations.
Expertise in aerospace and space industry design, development, and qualification.
Expert-level proficiency with electronics assemblies and experience working closely with electrical engineers on printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs, CCAs).
Expert-level proficiency with professional mechanical CAD (SolidWorks preferred) and FEA tools (Ansys preferred)
Experience with CNC manufacturing.
Experience with EMI/EMC mitigation techniques.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
